items.q: What is Cord Care That Won't Land You in A&E?
items.a: One evidence-based routine for the umbilical stump - plus the exact words to protect it from harmful 'remedies' without family war A clear daily cord-care routine and red-flag triage your whole household follows, so the stump heals safely and you know exactly when to see a doctor.

Mother or primary caregiver of a newborn (0-3 weeks), in Nigeria/Africa or the diaspora, responsible for daily umbilical stump care - often with conflicting advice from grandmothers, aunties and hospital staff about what to apply and what to avoid

You get 6 components: The Cord Care Guide - what is happening and the one house rule; Daily Care Kit - 30-second routine + house rule card; The Stump Decision Tree - normal vs worry triage; Cord Timeline Tracker - daily log + day-7/30 reviews; Script Pack - seven family conversations; RED FLAG Rescue Card - emergency routing.

No. Educational content - not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice. Never diagnoses or treats. Any suspected infection goes to professional care the same day. It does not replace professional assessment or care.
items.evidence_label: Educational content informed by sourced research and clinical guidance. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.
